description: Create an outbound X DM campaign that finds qualified leads and drafts personalized cold DMs for human approval. Requires a paid OpenTweet plan (Advanced or Agency) with a connected X account authorized for DMs. Human-in-the-loop: this does not send any DMs directly. Discovery finds and AI-qualifies leads and drafts messages; a human then approves sends in the OpenTweet app (or via dm_lead_approve), and approved messages are drip-scheduled and rate-limited before going out. Creating the campaign kicks off discovery: it pulls candidates from your chosen sources, filters and AI-qualifies them against your ideal-customer prompt, and drafts a tailored opening DM for each. Nothing is sent until a human approves the leads and the drip scheduler releases them under daily and per-account rate limits.

accept_policy.description: Must be true to confirm you accept OpenTweet's acceptable-use policy for cold outreach (no spam, honor opt-outs). The campaign cannot be created without it.

icp_prompt.description: Plain-language description of your ideal customer. Used by AI to score and qualify each candidate (e.g. "SaaS founders with 1k-50k followers who tweet about growth and are likely hiring").

active_hours_end.description: Hour (0-23, campaign timezone) sends must stop.

active_hours_start.description: Hour (0-23, campaign timezone) sends may start.

dms_per_day.description: Max DMs to send per day for this campaign (also capped by your plan).

timezone.description: IANA timezone for the active-hours window (e.g. "America/New_York").

message_brief.description: Brief the AI uses to draft each personalized DM. No links or em dashes are used in drafts.

cta.description: The call to action (e.g. "ask if they want a demo link").

follow_up_after_days.description: Days to wait before the follow-up (if enabled).

follow_up_enabled.description: Whether to send one follow-up DM if there is no reply.

offer.description: What you are offering / the point of the outreach. Used to draft each DM.

name.description: A name for the campaign (internal label)

rules_filter.description: Optional hard filters applied before AI qualification.

active_within_days.description: Only keep candidates who tweeted within this many days.

bio_exclude.description: Drop candidates whose bio contains one of these terms.

bio_include.description: Only keep candidates whose bio contains one of these terms.

score_threshold.description: Minimum AI qualification score (0-100) for a lead to reach the approval queue. Default 60.

sources.description: One or more lead sources to discover candidates from.

max_candidates.description: Max candidates to pull from this source (capped by your plan).

type.description: Where to find candidates: "search" (X search query), "followers_of" (a handle's followers), "tweet_engagers" (people who engaged a tweet), or "own_followers"

value.description: The source value: a search query for "search", an @handle for "followers_of", a tweet id or URL for "tweet_engagers". Ignored for "own_followers".

x_account_id.description: The connected X account ID that will send the DMs. Use dm-capable accounts; list accounts with opentweet_list_accounts.

name: dm_campaign_create
